market.summary: India had a strong fourth straight up day: the Nifty rose 1.58% and is about 5% higher in four sessions, helped by results, softer crude and foreign buying. That is good for open trades, but the rally is narrow: midcaps +0.8% and smallcaps +0.3% lagged. The NIFTY 500 sits right at its 50 DMA and still under its 200 DMA, so the screener's RISK-OFF size-down message stays, by a hair.

points.text: Nifty 23,810.85 (+1.58%), Sensex 76,917.85 (+1.62%), highest in nearly two months. FMCG +2.5%, Realty +2.1%, private banks +2%, Media +0.5%; PSU banks -1.4%, Energy -0.4%. Rupee 94.74, 16 paise stronger.

Provisional 3 Nov cash flows: FIIs bought Rs 6,837 Cr, DIIs sold Rs 3,679 Cr; a third straight FII buying day. NIFTY 500 22,520 vs 50 DMA 22,522 and 200 DMA 22,764; only 30% of tracked stocks are above their 21-day EMA.
Brent about $101.5 at 9:00 ET, down 3% on the day after Monday's 7% fall, on talk of progress toward a US-Iran deal; an Iranian official told Reuters the sides remain far apart.

US before the open: S&P futures +0.2%, Nasdaq-100 futures +0.8%, Dow futures -0.2%. The Nasdaq-100 closed Monday in a correction, over 10% under its 6 Oct high; Apple -4% on its margin forecast. AMD reports after the close. Closing figures were not available at this check.

market.watch: US midterm results (Wednesday morning India time onward), Iran talks, and the NIFTY 500 against its 200 DMA at 22,764.

GROWW.summary: No company filing or deal, but the sector had real news: the Finance Minister said she would consider feedback on equity taxes, and capital-market stocks rallied. Groww closed up 4.9% on about twice normal volume, back above entry at +0.43R. It is a hope-driven move, as no tax change was announced, so it helps the trade without changing the plan.

points.text: Close Rs 205.98 vs Rs 196.31 on 2 Nov, volume 2.05x normal; entry Rs 200.80, stop Rs 188.75, +1R Rs 212.85.

Nirmala Sitharaman, in Mumbai, acknowledged investor concerns about capital gains tax and said the feedback would be considered; she announced no relief. Angel One rose nearly 8%, CDSL nearly 6.5%, and the Nifty Capital Markets index over 3%.
6 accumulation vs 1 distribution day in 25 sessions; no bulk, block or short deal in 10 days; last filing is the 16 Oct call transcript.

GROWW.watch: A close at or above Rs 212.85 (+1R) moves the stop to cost; the stop stays Rs 188.75 until then.

SEJALLTD.summary: No filing, deal or news today. The stock bounced 6.4% to 828.55, but on only 0.42x normal volume and still 1.1% under the 838.03 stop, so the closing-basis exit signal stands at -1.21R. A bounce this thin does not repair the break, though it does close most of the gap to the stop.

points.text: Close Rs 828.55 vs Rs 778.55 on 2 Nov; average cost Rs 884.13, stop Rs 838.03, -6.3%. Over 5 sessions it is -4.6% while its index is +3.3%.
Monthly RSI still shows a bearish divergence. Last filing is the 27 Oct call transcript; no deals in 10 days.

SEJALLTD.watch: The exit signal stays open in My trades; only a close above Rs 838.03 clears it.

THELEELA.summary: A normal pause after Monday's jump: the stock fell 2.7% to 652.85 on below-average volume, and the trade is still +1.55R with the stop above cost. The sector read was good, as Samhi's quarter showed strong room rates and occupancy. Yesterday's investor meet filing could not be opened here, so its content is not verified; such schedules are normally routine.

points.text: Close Rs 652.85 vs Rs 671.05, volume 0.66x; entry Rs 604.51, swing stop Rs 605.71 (21 EMA), position stop Rs 604.51. Weekly RSI 75, overbought.
Samhi Hotels Q2 FY27: total income +15.6%, RevPAR +14.3% on a 9.2% higher room rate, occupancy 78.6% vs 75.0%; management expects a stronger second half.
Filing 2 Nov 20:44 IST: intimation of schedule of investor meet (not read).

THELEELA.watch: Whether it holds above the 21 EMA near Rs 606; stops are on a closing basis.

INDHOTEL.summary: The stock closed at a new peak of 836.05, up 1.6%, and above +1R at 831.19. Under the plan the stop now moves up to cost at 785.83, so the trade no longer risks capital on a closing basis. Samhi's strong quarter also supports the hotel demand story. Friday's analyst meet filing still could not be opened here, so its content is not verified.

points.text: Close Rs 836.05 vs Rs 822.50, volume 0.86x; entry Rs 785.83, now +1.11R (+6.4%); stop moves to cost Rs 785.83, +2R Rs 876.55. Weekly RSI 72, overbought.
Samhi Hotels Q2 FY27: RevPAR +14.3%, occupancy 78.6%, with domestic travellers about 80% of room nights.
Filing 30 Oct 17:38 IST: schedule of an analyst / institutional meet, attachment named for 5 Nov (not read).

INDHOTEL.watch: Trail on a closing basis: cost / 21 EMA; +2R at Rs 876.55.

TIPSMUSIC.summary: No filing, deal or company news today. The stock edged up 0.3% to 787.25 on about half normal volume, in line with a quiet Media index. The trade is +0.9R with the stop at cost, so nothing has changed.

points.text: Close Rs 787.25 vs Rs 784.95, volume 0.47x; entry Rs 727.89, swing stop Rs 732.70 (21 EMA), position stop Rs 727.89; peak close Rs 793.90.
Nifty Media rose 0.5% on a day the Nifty rose 1.58%.

TIPSMUSIC.watch: A close above the Rs 793.90 peak resumes the move; a close under Rs 732.70 is the swing stop.

BHAGERIA.summary: You bought today at 367.46 and it closed just below at 365.45, near the day's low, so the first day shows no follow-through. The numbers behind the trade are strong (revenue +123%, profit +374%), but there is one thing to know: an old SEBI order is still in court. The stop is close at 360.01, about 1.5% away, so the risk is small and clear.

points.text: Close Rs 365.45, in the lower 21% of the day's range, volume 0.79x; entry Rs 367.46, stop Rs 360.01, +1R Rs 374.91; result-day low Rs 363.65.
Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 455.70 Cr (+123% YoY), profit Rs 55.92 Cr (+374%). No concall notice was found on NSE, so nothing has explained the jump; weekly RSI 73, overbought.
A SEBI adjudication order of 31 Mar 2023 was challenged by promoters and directors at the appeals tribunal and is stayed; the March filing gives no penalty amount.
The tribunal's next date is reported as 5 Jan 2027, with the stay continuing. The 22 Oct filing itself could not be opened here, so this rests on a secondary report.
CARE reaffirmed CARE A (stable) / A1 on Rs 91 Cr of bank facilities and removed the negative watch.

BHAGERIA.watch: A close under Rs 360.01 is the stop; the plan's own trigger is Rs 370.75. Tribunal date 5 Jan 2027.
